gaps.sentence: This form ___ (sign) in ink — digital signatures aren't valid.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: modal + be + past participle. Obligation: must (also has to) be signed.

gaps.sentence: Parcels ___ (leave) in the porch if nobody is home.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: should be + left. A recommendation; 'are left' (routine) is also acceptable.

gaps.sentence: Passengers ___ (ask) to fasten their seatbelts before take-off.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: are + asked. The agent (crew) is obvious and omitted.

gaps.sentence: The tickets ___ at the door from seven o'clock.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: can be + collected. The tickets are collected by the buyers.

gaps.sentence: The ambush ___ (plan) by someone with intimate knowledge of the valley.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive (had been planned) stresses completion before the ambush; was planned is also acceptable.

gaps.sentence: The museum ___ (close) to the public on Mondays.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: is + closed. No agent needed; the routine is what matters.

gaps.sentence: A new ring road ___ (construct) around the city at present.
gaps.explanation: 'At present' requires present continuous passive: is being + constructed.

gaps.sentence: The new bridge ___ (open) by the mayor next month.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + opened, with the agent in a by-phrase.
